SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Do you have a moment?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hmm? What is it? Even though I finally got in the mood.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] "We have no choice but to do it"... is what you said just now, right?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Yeah! Is there anything wrong with that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] But your legs are shaking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Gah! T-This is the pre-battle excitement!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Could it be that you think we can't win?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Heh, I'm not going to chicken out after coming so far!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] That's what I'm hoping for.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's an exaggeration...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Hm... I simply gauged your confidence.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Anyway, am I a burden?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Yes.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] That's too blunt! Be a little tactful!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] There's no need for that, know that I believe in you.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Haha. Well, I guess it's true.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] You're indeed a burden, but that's all.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Hm? What do you mean by that?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] This level of handicap is perfect.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't say I'm a handicap!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Handicap.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't say I'm a handicap!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I'm not like that at all--!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Besides, it seems like you're pretty confident.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] In a match, the one thinking about defeat before it starts is going to lose.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] ...Kuroneko.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] If you lack self-confidence, hide behind me.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] O-Okay...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] So you 'were' thinking about defeat.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't mess with me!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I too, can do things when I need to!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I hope so.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Don't take me for a fool! I've undergone training after all!

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] I can't lose when we've made it this far!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Heh, unknowingly your legs stopped shaking.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Eh?
[FI] She... did it to calm me down...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Can you do it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ah, yeah... No problem. Let's go, Kuroneko!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] ...Yes.
[FI] I-I can't deny it.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I'll say it now.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W-What is it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] On the battlefield, there is no "good effort", only winners and losers.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] It's not "I have to win" or "I want to win". It's "I win". Get it?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I can fight while covering you; we will still win.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] W- Where does this self-confidence come from?

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] I feel pity for your lack of self-confidence.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Ugh...

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Because of that, that sister of yours always gets her way.

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] How pitiful.

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Shut up! You're making me lose more confidence!

SPEAKER: SPK_KURONEKO
TEXT: [FI] Well then, should we go?

SPEAKER: SPK_KYOUSUKE
TEXT: [FI] Y-Yeah!
